agent.descriptionPlaceholder: E.g. Product questions, prices, stock and buying advice.
agent.descriptionHelp: Used by the receptionist and by transfers to decide who gets the conversation.
agent.transferToHelp: If the customer asks about something another agent handles, it hands over the conversation and that agent replies right away.
agent.transferToHelpNone: If you pick none, this agent doesn't transfer.
agent.transferToHelpRouter: If you pick none, the receptionist can transfer to every active agent that isn't a receptionist.
agent.noOtherAgents: Create another agent to be able to transfer conversations to it.
agent.noDescription: No description: add one so transfers can find it.
agent.modelHelp: If the chosen provider isn't configured or fails, another available one is used.

playground.title: Try “{name}”
playground.description: Chat as if you were a customer. It uses your real business data, but nothing is sent, booked or stored.
playground.empty: Write a message to start. E.g. “Hi, how much is…?”
playground.handoverWould: Would hand the conversation to a team member
playground.bookingConfirm: Would confirm the booking (nothing is booked in this test)
playground.bookingCancel: Would cancel the customer's next booking
playground.llmUnavailable: No AI provider is configured. A platform admin must add a key (Gemini, DeepSeek or OpenAI) in Admin panel → Settings → AI providers.
playground.disabledNote: This agent is disabled: you can try it, but it won't reply to customers until you enable it.

menu.title: Welcome menu
menu.dialogDescription: When customers first write, they pick an option and the matching agent or your team takes over. E.g. “What are you looking for? Products / Support / Planning”.
menu.enabledHelp: When on, the menu takes priority over the channel's agent in new conversations.
menu.question: Question
menu.buttonLabelHelp: With more than 3 options it's sent as a list; this text opens it.
menu.label: Option text
menu.descriptionHint: Only shown when the menu is sent as a list (more than 3 options).
menu.limitHint: Up to 3 options are sent as buttons (max 20 characters); 4 to 10 as a list (max 24).
menu.previewEmpty: Add a question and options to see the preview.
menu.previewOther: On Instagram, Messenger and the web chat it adapts to quick replies or a numbered menu.
menu.noAgents: You have no AI agents yet: options can only go to your human team.

flowNode.noAgents: You have no AI agents yet.
flowNode.help: When the run reaches this step the flow ends and this agent takes over the conversation, replying to the customer's message right away.

inbox.noneChannel: No agent of its own (uses the channel's: {name})
inbox.cleared: The conversation follows the channel's setup again

flowMenu.nativeHelp: The customer taps an option. They can also type its number (1, 2, 3…) or its name.
flowMenu.numberedHelp: Sent as text with numbered options. The customer replies with the number (1, 2, "two", "option 2") or the option's name. Up to 10 options.
flowMenu.defaultFooter: Reply with the number of your choice.
